{{Quote|Well, we'll need a new Keshiri bearer for the ward-room.''"<br />"''What happened to the last one, Orlenda? Did you finally kill him with your kindnesses?''"<br />"''No. He's dead.|Orlenda and Seelah Korsin, referring to Gorem|<ref name="paragon" />}}
'''Gorem''' was a [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] servant of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Gorem worked as a bearer in the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ward-room, where he grew close to a [[Gender/Legends|woman]] named [[Orlenda]]. In [[4985 BBY]], he was sent to work on the crashed Sith [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Omen]]'', in order to recover anything that could be useful. While toiling away in an apothecary, Gorem came into contact with the deadly compound [[cyanogen silicate]], which [[Death/Legends|killed]] him soon after. His death gave his supervisor, [[Ravilan Wroth]], the idea to use cyanogen silicate to create the appearance of a mysterious [[Disease/Legends|plague]], which would force the Sith leaders to focus on a way off Kesh.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The big one? Gosem?"<br />"''Gorem''. Yes, he died last week. We'd loaned him to Ravilan's team breaking down one of the decks of the ''Omen'', looking for whatever it is they look for to use.|Seelah Korsin and Orlenda|<ref name="paragon" />}}
[[File:Lost_Sith_Tribe_world.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Gorem was a native of the planet Kesh.]]
A [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]], Gorem was a [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], where he lived in the era after the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. Gorem served the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]],<ref name="paragon" /> a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] castaways who had crashed on the remote world in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], and convinced the Keshiri to worship them as [[Deity/Legends|gods]].<ref name="Precipice">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]''</ref> Gorem worked as a bearer for the ward-room where the [[Youngling/Legends|children]] of the Lost Tribe were [[Reproduction/Legends|born]], and by [[4985 BBY]] had begun a flirtation with a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] named [[Orlenda]], the assistant to prominent Sith and head [[Medic/Legends|medic]] [[Seelah Korsin]].<ref name="paragon" />

Physically strong, that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] Gorem was sent to work under [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Ravilan Wroth]], breaking down the decks of the crashed Sith [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Omen]]'' in search of whatever the Lost Tribe could use. While working on the ship's [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] apothecary, Gorem touched a deck plate stained with the lethal compound [[cyanogen silicate]]. When he washed his [[Limb/Legends|hands]], the cyanogen silicate intensified, and he [[Death/Legends|died]] not long after. For his [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]], Gorem's body was thrown over a nearby cliff into the [[Ocean/Legends|sea]]. Orlenda later explained the circumstances of Gorem's death and funeral to Korsin while examining Human Lost Tribe children as part of their efforts to ensure the [[Speciesism|Human purity]] and [[Gene/Legends|genetic]] perfection of the Sith.<ref name="paragon" />

Wroth had been searching for a way to convince his superiors, namely Lost Tribe leader [[Yaru Korsin]], to withdraw from Keshiri affairs and focus on finding a way offplanet. Inspired by Gorem's death, Wroth used cyanogen silicate to kill thousands in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tetsubal]], in an attempt to frighten Korsin with the appearance of a mysterious [[Disease/Legends|plague]]. After subsequent "outbreaks" in other nearby towns, Wroth's plan was discovered, and he was [[Speciecide|executed]] along with most of the rest of the Lost Tribe's [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]] members.<ref name="paragon" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Gorem was, well you remember, so ''strong''&mdash;|Orlenda|<ref name="paragon" />}}
With a beefy physique, Gorem was very physically strong and well-suited to labor, which led to confusion as to the cause of his death while working on the ''Omen''. Gorem was particularly close with the human female Orlenda, who was quite enamored with him.<ref name="paragon" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gorem was mentioned in [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[2010]] [[eBook]], ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]''.<ref name="paragon" />
